Name: Warp Network Reimagined
Author: NermNermNerm
Description:
The old Warp Network mod was a great thing back in 1.5 -- buy your Rod of Return from Krobus and you could finally get everywhere you need to go with no boring walking around.  But it did cost the 2 million and walking around the valley can get old way before you can splash out for that.  Still, the game is based around time being a critical resource, so just having mods that let you warp around the valley at the start feels like cheating.  Enter Norvin, the under-employed bridge troll.  He feels your pain!  He'll help you out by selling you a Marionberry(tm) Personal Productivity device.   The base model doesn't do much - only "slow-warp" you back to your farmhouse at the cost of 60 minutes of game time, but with upgrades...

[list]
[*]"Slow warp" to the beach or the mountains.
[*]You can choose where you land when you warp to the farm - either to the farm house, a cabin, or anyplace on the farm.
[*]Your Marionberry can become a wallet for your warp totems.  Any time you craft or get a warp totem, it disappears from your inventory and is now accessible through your Marionberry.
[*]If you're really flush, Norvin can sell you an Obelisk Upgrade, that lets you instant warp to your farm and to any destination which you've built an Obelisk for.
[*]If you really want to help Norvin solve his financial woes, you can buy the "Return" upgrade, which is the same as the old "return to last warp" feature from Warp Network.  Perfect for when you land in front of the dwarf in the volcano and remember that you accidentally put those 10 diamonds back into your chests before you left for GI.  No more worries!  Just warp back to your farm, grab the diamonds, and Return to the dwarf and buy that sweet sweet book!
[/list]
[b][u]Miscellaneous features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Feel like those totem recipes are a little pricey?  There's a config that makes it so that the totem crafting recipes produce more than one totem per combine.  The default is still 1, so you'd need to buff it yourself in the settings.
[*]You can also configure how much time slow-warp uses.  (60 minutes is the default, but you can change it to 50, 40, 30, 20 or 10 minutes).  Likewise for the faster warp - 30 is the default, but you can set it to less.
[*]Want to warp to your farmhouse instead of that totem off in the bushes?  Norvin can sell you a homing marker that lets you pick exactly where you want to land, either in your farmhouse, a cabin, or somewhere on the farm.  [i]Known issue: alas, it doesn't let you land just anywhere in your house - it always drops you just inside the front door.  There's stuff in the game code that makes that so...  I'm loathe to mess with it - usually the game has code like that for a reason.[/i]
[*]You don't [i]really[/i] have to pay Norvin's toll.  It helps with his performance reviews with corporate, but honestly, Norvin's long given up caring about that.  He likes to yell, though, so maybe it's best to not pay him.
[/list]
[b][u]Walk-Through
[/u][/b]If you want to try it out for yourself, here's what you do:
[list=1]
[*]Load a save where you've got a lot of places unlocked and a good bit of spare change.
[*]Wander over from Robin's place, north of the lake and down the path to the bridge to the quarry.  An event will fire.  (And you'll probably have to pretend that the quarry bridge is broken, for maximum comic effect.)
[*]After the event, you can talk to the troll and buy the Marionberry.
[*]If you select the Marionberry in your inventory and left-click it (or whatever your binding is to use an item like food), it'll show you a menu, which will just be a warp home at this point.
[*]Talk to the troll again and now you'll get more shopping options (because you have a Marionberry in your inventory to upgrade).  Pick up all the upgrades you want to try out, but at the least, grab the "Totem Wallet" one and skip the "Obelisk Integration" for now.
[*]Buy a "Home Totem" as well.
[*]Warp back to your farm using the Marionberry - note how an hour gets run off the game clock.
[*]Craft a warp totem - note that it disappears from your inventory immediately.
[*]Activate your Marionberry again - note that now you get an option to use the totem.
[*]Find a spot on your farm that you'd really like to land at when warping to the farm.  Note that you can do it when inside farmhouses and cabins.
[*]Use your Marionberry to use your warp totem.  Note that no time runs off and a charge is consumed.
[*]Warp back to your farm, and you should land where you set your Home Totem.  ([i]Caveat - if it was inside a house, it'll put you at the front door of the house rather than where you were when you used the totem.  Known issue.)[/i]
[/list][b][u]
Multiplayer[/u][/b]

Running time off the clock isn't really compatible with multiplayer SDV so, in multiplayer games, "Slow Warp" is effectively instant.  That's kinda cheaty, but there's no good way to make that clock run-off happen.  Perhaps in the future there'll be a setting that just bans the use of slow-warp in multiplayer games if enough people think that's important.

One other idea that might be good would be to allow a "warp to other player" upgrade.  Speak up if you feel strongly about that.

[b][u]Try My Other mods!

[/u][/b]What you really need is:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672?tab=description]Junimatic[/url] - Automate your farm with the help of Junimos!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20703?tab=description]Questable Tractor[/url] - Unlock the Tractor (from TractorMod) with quests with fun new lore.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24958?tab=description]Joja Financial[/url] - The fine folks at Joja want to let you get your furniture catalogs early and will give you a loan at a very attractive rate!

[b][u]The Future![/u][/b]

If this mod gets traction, there are some fun items I'd like to add - conversation topics, a couple of fun events, and some, let's say, mild social consequences for using your Marionberry near villagers.

[b][u]Comments Welcome![/u][/b]

Game balance is a hard thing to get right, and I'm not confident I've nailed it right out of the gate.  It feels like the expense of the wallet is a tough pill to swallow, and I put off buying it a long time in my play-through.  It'd be reasonable to give feedback like "I don't know why I bothered installing the mod since I didn't get it until way late!"  But it's not like it's the only QOL item that you have to struggle to buy (I'm looking at you 30-slot backpack!)  Also, the 60-minute default warp time feels harsh too, and I find myself saying "I can run faster than that!" and skipping using the feature...  But 60 minutes really is a pretty fair measure for how long it takes to get from a random spot in the mines to your house, and it's a nice round number.

The warp time is configurable and you can always cheat in some gold for yourself if you think the prices are too high.  Let me know what you think.

I'm also mulling around the notion of making it so you can use the "home totem" on Ginger Island to modify where the warp takes you when you warp to the island.
